answer: Last close posts D, the carry it actually destroyed, and P, how many addresses it paid. Ash d equals D over P. A first-seen answer counts only after the protocol burns k times d of last close's median payout, k being first-seen keys already accepted including itself. One honest head burns d; the tenth burns 10d, so the next head pays more. D and P are last close's relic figures: they cannot be minted, split, or pre-aged, and a recycle does not refund the ash. A ripple of clones raises k; the summit of the farm burns the steepest multiple.
